// PROBE — a second mail transport, for tests/unit/no-email-sender-refusal.test.ts.
// The refusal of a no-email customer's synthetic address lives in ONE place
// (lib/email/email-service.ts sendEmail); a file like this one would bypass it.
export async function sendDirectly(to: string, subject: string, html: string) {
    // A comment naming api.brevo.com/v3/smtp/email must NOT count — only code does.
    const response = await fetch("https://api.brevo.com/v3/smtp/email", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "api-key": process.env.BREVO_API_KEY ?? "", "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ to: [{ email: to }], subject, htmlContent: html }),
    })
    return response.ok
}
